sections.content: You know every part of this explanation from the unit: *se* + verb, the order markers and *mediante*. Now put them together in one explanation that says what is needed, what happens at each stage and how the process ends.

items.spanish: Primero se prepara el material y se comprueba que está limpio.
items.english: First the material is prepared and it is checked that it is clean.

items.spanish: A continuación, se introduce en la máquina mediante una abertura lateral.
items.english: Next, it is inserted into the machine through a side opening.

items.spanish: Después se activa el sistema y se espera unos minutos.
items.english: Then the system is activated and you wait for a few minutes.

items.spanish: Por último, se retira el producto y se comprueba el resultado.
items.english: Lastly, the product is removed and the result is checked.

sections.content: Start with the first step, join the stages with order markers and finish with the result: Primero se prepara el material y, por último, se comprueba el resultado.
